Name: Bathroom Furniture for Alternative Textures
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=5][b]Alternative Textures - Bathroom Furniture by FarmerBeans
[/b][/size][size=4]All I ever wanted in Stardew Valley was a toilet! This pack gives you 6 to choose from!  Plus sinks, tubs, showers, and more that you can display all around Pelican Town.  Includes over 120 new textures. 
[/size]
[size=5]Need the[b] Content Patcher Version [/b]instead?
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26354][size=4]Grab it here[/size]
[/url]
[size=5]Textures include:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Toilets[/size]
[*][size=3]Bathtubs[/size]
[*][size=3]Single and Double sinks[/size]
[*][size=3]Countertops[/size]
[*][size=3]Shower doors and walls[/size]
[*][size=3]Bathmats[/size]
[*][size=3]Wall Shelves[/size]
[*][size=3]Hanging Plants[/size]
[*][size=3]Clothes rack[/size]
[*][size=3]Hamper[/size]
[*][size=3]Bottles[/size]
[/list][list]
[/list]
[size=5]How to Use
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install Alternative Textures Mod[/size]
[*][size=3]Purchase the paint bucket from Robin[/size]
[*][size=3]Use the paint bucket on any of the catalog furniture or decor listed above[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Furniture Reference (Thanks [/size][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TravellerKiedra/about-me?gameId=1303]TravelerKiedra [/url][size=5]for writing this out) [/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Bathtub & Clothes Rack[/b][/size][size=3]:  Tree of the Winter Star, Exotic Tree, Deluxe Tree.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Shower Stall shower nozzle and taps[/b]: All decorative doors,  Model Planes﻿,  "'Squid Kid﻿'" banner.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Shower Towel rack / shower curtain[/b]:  All tall bookcases, Fancy House Plant, Cat Tree, Dark Cat Tree, Budget TV, Butterfly Hutch, Wumbus  Statue, Bobo Statue, Retro TV, Radio Desk.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Toilet[/b]: any chair, but not benches or couches.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Sink[/b]: All dressers[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Sink cabinet[/b]: All end tables.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Wall Mirrors / Bathroom Shelves[/b]: Looks like all paintings (unsure), Miner's Crest, Marriage Candidate Portraits, Krobus Portrait, Wall Basket, Pyramid Decal, Cloud Decal, Pierre's Sign, Periodic Table, Dusty Skull.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Rugs[/b]:   Light Green Rug,  Joja Rug, Swirl Rug,  Red Rug, Patchwork Rug, Dark Rug, Red Cottage Rug, Green Cottage Rug, Mystic Rug, Pirate Rug,  Bone Rug, Fruit Salad Rug, Snowy Rug, Oceanic Rug, Junimo Mat, Retro Rug.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Bathroom items you can place, eg rubber ducks, bath products[/b]: Potted Red Mushroom, Retro Flower, Plastic Plant, Plastic Sapling,  Small Junimo Pot, Small Plant, Table Plant, Decorative Bowl, Small Crystal, Futan Bear, Small Junimo Plush, Futan Rabbit, Joja Cola Cans, Cash Register, Elixir Bundle, "Two Elixirs".[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Cupboards[/b] (3 tiles height, 1 tile wide): Ceramic Pillar, Gold Pillar, Industrial Pipe, Indoor Palm, Totem Pole, Manicured Pine, Topiary Tree, Tree Column, Purple Serpent Statue, Green Serpent Statue, Long Cactus, Calico Statue, Coat Stand, Bird House, Tall House Plant", Corn Plant.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]toilet paper roll, towel on a rack, hanging flower baskets[/b]: 3 tile tall, 1 tile wide items like Wall Flower, S. Wall Flower, various banners like Clouds Banner, Jungle decal, decorative tools like Axe, log panel, Wall Palm, Wall Cactus, Sam's Skateboard, leafy wall panels, outlet.[/size]
[/list]
